title: TNT Dome 3 Key
subtitle: Clara's key trail for the Nuka-Cola dome at Black Mountain Ordnance Works

sections.title: How to Start
sections.html:
There's no quest to start. The trail begins at Pylon V-13 in the Cranberry Bog. Bring lockpicking for the Nuka-Cola plant.

{img:tnt-dome-locations-map}

sections.title: TNT Dome 3 Key Walkthrough
sections.html:
Step 1 – Go to Pylon V-13

Fast travel to Pylon V-13 in the Cranberry Bog. Enemies hang around the pylon and Super Mutants are nearby.

{img:dome-3-pylon-v-13}

Step 2 – Take the Toolbox Key

Face north to the concrete pillar with stairs up to the monorail. Go round its left side and keep heading north, looking for a red bush and then a tree stump. On the stump is a note, beside it a skeleton, and in the green duffle bag the Toolbox Key.

{img:dome-3-toolbox-key-duffle-bag}{note:BMO_BunkerNote03_CrazyLadyWatoga}

Step 3 – Go to Watoga Shopping Plaza

Fast travel to Watoga Shopping Plaza. Face east and go down the road past the truck and ute to the end of the yellow bus, then north to the middle of the music stage.

{img:dome-3-watoga-shopping-plaza}

Step 4 – Open Clara's toolbox

From the stage face east to the edge of the rocks before the water, then face south: a red toolbox and a skeleton sit on the rocks. The Toolbox Key opens it. Take the Key to Clara's Box.

{img:dome-3-claras-toolbox}

Step 5 – Go to the Overseer's house in Sutton

Fast travel to the Overseer's Home in Sutton and turn right. A blue house is ahead on the left, a red-orange house behind it and a white-green house to its right. Stand between the red-orange and white-green houses.

{img:dome-3-sutton-overseers-house}

Step 6 – Open the crate in the doghouse

Follow the wire-and-post fence on your right to a red doghouse with a black roof. The yellow crate inside opens with the Key to Clara's Box: take the Nuka-Cola Locker Key and Clara's note. Check the baseball bat on the back of the ute by the doghouse too.

{img:dome-3-doghouse-crate}{note:BMO_BunkerNote03_MomGoodbyeNoteSutton}

Step 7 – Go into the Kanawha Nuka-Cola Plant

Fast travel to the Kanawha Nuka-Cola Plant. Take the road north over the bridge, turn right at the Nuka-Cola sign and follow it to the car park (blowing up the cars first is safer). Walk between the Nuka-Cola bottles on the left and go through the door on your left.

{img:dome-3-nuka-cola-plant-entrance}

Step 8 – Go upstairs

Inside, face west through the double doorway. Take the first stairs up on your right and at the top go north through the door.

{img:dome-3-nuka-cola-plant-stairs}

Step 9 – Pick the level 1 door

Face west and walk past two terminals (there's a level 3 safe by the last one). The level 1 locked door is on your right; loot the sugar and honey here too.

{img:dome-3-nuka-cola-plant-locked-door}

Step 10 – Cross the locker room

Through the door, turn left to the end of the room (another level 3 safe sits by the white lockers).

{img:dome-3-nuka-cola-plant-lockers}

Step 11 – Find the fallen white locker

Go left through the doorway at the end, follow the wall on your right to its end, then turn left: a white locker lies on the ground.

{img:dome-3-nuka-cola-plant-white-locker}

Step 12 – Take TNT Dome Key 3

The Nuka-Cola Locker Key opens it. TNT Dome Key 3 is inside.

{img:dome-3-key}

Two more notes in the plant fill in the story: Clara's note to Alexis is in a locked metal box, and a Nuka-Cola marketing memo lies on a desk.

{note:BMO_BunkerNote03_Lockernote}{note:BMO_BunkerNote03_MarketingMemo}

sections.title: Finding the Dome
sections.html:
Step 13 – Find Dome 3

Fast travel to Black Mountain Ordnance Works. Follow the road south past the car to the T-junction, turn left and go east past a Protectron and the Blood Eagles. Keep straight, watching for a large grey rock pile at the road's edge on your left. Face north and walk straight: the dome door is on your right. The key opens it.

{img:dome-3-door}

sections.title: Rewards
sections.html:
Inside TNT Dome 3:

  • {name:recipe_mod_PowerArmor_T51_Material_Paint_NukaCola}
  • 2 outfit spots, each one of: Cappy, Nuka-World, Bottle and Cappy Red, Bottle and Cappy Orange or Nuka-World Geyser Jacket & Jeans
  • 12 Nuka-Cola and 7 Nuka-Cola Quantum spots in the orange carts, plus InstaMash
{img:dome-3-reward-spots}{img:t-51-power-armor-nuka-cola-paint,cappy-jacket-and-jeans,nuka-world-jacket-and-jeans,bottle-and-cappy-red-jacket-and-jeans,bottle-and-cappy-orange-jacket-and-jeans,nuka-world-geyser-jacket-and-jeans}

sections.title: FAQ and Important Info
sections.html:
Which outfit will I get?

Each of the two outfit spots picks one of the five at random, so you may need a few visits for all of them.

Is this a quest?

No. There's no quest and nothing in your Pip-Boy tracks it: the keys, notes and codes are the trail.

What about domes 1, 4, 5 and 6?

Their doors can't be opened. Notes for domes 5 and 6 exist in the game files but aren't placed anywhere, so they look like unfinished content.

sections.title: Lore
sections.html:
Black Mountain Ordnance Works is based on a real place, the West Virginia Ordnance Works. The records terminal in its main building (Cole & Parker Holdings LTD) has an entry for each dome; for domes 1, 4, 5 and 6 it only shows DATA READ ERROR.

Dome 3's entry lists the Nuka-Cola Corporation on a 12-year lease, with an option to renew for another 25 years, paid in full.
